topology.idler_model: Frictionless palm-fixed guide path baseline. Sampled quarter-circle represents fixed cable-centerline routing; wheel bearing friction and finite wrap are not inferred from it.
topology.unsupported: Do not directly command/lock finger qpos, add coupling equality between proximal/distal, multiply tension by ad-hoc efficiency, or omit spool reaction torque.

cable_model.motor_limit: Apply torque limit to the three spool servo actuators; do not cap cable force independently of rotor dynamics. External loads can backdrive/pay out through the same reaction.
cable_model.builtin_tendon_parameters: Set stiffness=0 damping=0 frictionloss=0 when helper applies cable forces; otherwise forces are counted twice.
cable_model.stiffness_basis: Explicit unmeasured axial compliance scenarios; 1 N extension = 2.0/0.6667/0.2 mm respectively. Material, knots and effective line length not purchased/measured.
cable_model.damping_note: Optional nonnegative c; helper gates it by tautness and verifies dissipative clipping. Actual damping unknown.
cable_model.motor_caveat: Explicit scenario bounds, not continuous ratings or confirmation of purchased compatible MG90S performance.
cable_model.timestep_note: Custom cable stiffness is applied explicitly. dt=0.0005 s must be checked by halving dt; stiff cable + small rotor inertia can excite high elastic frequencies. helper local_cable_stiffness enables M^-1 K frequency inspection.

geometry_results.winding_caveat: Add initial slack and elastic extension to stroke; constant 8mm line center radius assumes single-layer winding.

root.status: unmeasured design sensitivity; neither validated tolerance nor calibrated material property
root.formula: k=E*d^4/(C*(ID+d)*(N+2*R/(3*pi*(ID+d)))) ; C in {64,10.8*2*pi}; SI torque after Nmm -> Nm
root.caveat: E, diameter and ID bounds are inherited analysis scenarios, not measurements of the unpurchased springs. The current CAD assumes fabricated wire springs; catalog alternatives need mount redesign and are excluded here.

primary_documentation.use: Spatial tendon sites/length definition; zero built-in stiffness for helper coupling. Native springlength deadbands alone do not provide the required independent winch reaction coordinate.
Scalar actuator force maps through transmission moment arms. Use three motor torque inputs at spools, not six hidden finger motors.
Update kinematics/velocity before external force evaluation; helper force applied between split steps.
